lines.t: Hear and seek to understand
The Word of God is fire
Each word a burning flame
In the midst of an immense fire
Fire, fire, the countenance of the Lord is a fire, fire, and a flame within a fire, fire, the glory of the Lord is perfect, a pure light, a flame within a flame.
A fire engulfing all creation
Yahuwah is one, one, one
And His name, one, one, one
His name is in Him and is Him
Yahuwah is His name
And His name is one with Him
They are not separate, but one, even as the Father and the Son are one.
A flame within a flame, within an immense fire.
Yahuwah has no beginning and no end even as his name therefore nothing is outside
Yahuwah for his being is infinite and those who pass outside creation enter
into his eternal glory or are burned up in his devouring fire in his everlasting
Shalom.
For Yah is holy
And all those void of the flame will consume away
They shall cease to exist
For all must pass through the fire
Or subject to the power of the flame
The wicked purged and the penitent purified
Thanks for watching!
